    classDef entity fill:#f9d79b,stroke:#e67e22,stroke-width:2px

    VS[(Visualization Store)]:::datastore

    User -->|Request data| HCE
    HCE -->|Send network data| DC
    DC -->|Store collected data| NDS
    NDS -->|Retrieve data| DP
    DP -->|Store processed data| VS
    VS -->|Retrieve data| V
    V -->|Present visualized data| User

graph TD
    %% Base styling for consistent font size
    classDef default font-size:14px;

    %% Define Entities (Rounded Rectangles for Systems, Circle for User)

    OpenSourceNetworkingTools(Open Source Networking Tools)

    %% Define Processes (Rectangles)
    DataCollection[Data Collection]
    DataProcessing[Data Processing]
    Visualization[Visualization]

    %% Define Data Stores (Cylinders)
    NetworkDataStore[(Network Data Store)]

Here is the conceptual flowchart illustrating the progression and interrelation of the key quantum mechanics concepts. The diagram uses a vertical layout (`graph TD`), grouping the concepts into four distinct color-coded categories: **Equations** (light red), **Mathematical Formalisms & Objects** (light blue), **Foundational Hypotheses** (light green), and **Principles & Constraints** (light yellow). ```mermaid graph TD %% Class Definitions for Color-Coding classDef eq fill:#fadbd8,stroke:#c0392b,stroke-width:2px,color:#000; classDef math fill:#d6eaf8,stroke:#2980b9,stroke-width:2px,color:#000; classDef hyp fill:#d5f5e3,stroke:#27ae60,stroke-width:2px,color:#000; classDef princ fill:#fcf3cf,stroke:#f1c40f,stroke-width:2px,color:#000; %% Node Definitions final_result["Time-Dependent Schrödinger Equation
Final form of the equation: iħ(∂ψ/∂t) = Hψ"]:::eq time_independent_schrodinger["Time-Independent Schrödinger Equation
Separation of variables: Hψ = Eψ"]:::eq hamiltonian_operator["Hamiltonian Operator
Definition: H = T + V, where T is the kinetic energy and V is the potential energy"]:::math wave_function["Wave Function
Postulate: The wave function ψ contains all the information of the quantum system"]:::math energy_eigenstates["Energy Eigenstates
Assumption: ψ can be expressed in terms of energy eigenstates"]:::math de_broglie_hypothesis["de Broglie Hypothesis
Hypothesis: Particles exhibit wave-like properties, wavelength λ = h/p"]:::hyp schrodinger_hypothesis["Schrödinger's Hypothesis
Hypothesis: Proposed a wave equation to describe the dynamics of quantum particles"]:::hyp boundary_conditions["Boundary Conditions
Conditions: Ensure the wave function ψ is finite, continuous, and single-valued"]:::princ classical_mechanics_limit["Correspondence Principle
Principle: Quantum mechanics must reduce to classical mechanics in the limit of large quantum numbers"]:::princ operators["Operators
Definition: Use of operators for observables like momentum (p̂ = -iħ∇) and energy"]:::math %% Connections with Descriptive Labels final_result -->|Separates into| time_independent_schrodinger time_independent_schrodinger -->|Employs| hamiltonian_operator hamiltonian_operator -->|Acts upon| wave_function wave_function -->|Expanded via| energy_eigenstates energy_eigenstates -->|Manifests| de_broglie_hypothesis de_broglie_hypothesis -->|Foundation of| schrodinger_hypothesis wave_function -->|Subject to| boundary_conditions boundary_conditions -->|Constrains| schrodinger_hypothesis wave_function -->|Must adhere to| classical_mechanics_limit classical_mechanics_limit -->|Validates| operators operators -->|Formulates| schrodinger_hypothesis ```
